name: outlier_in_typhimurium_cohort
mechanism: A cohort of three Salmonella Typhimurium isolates at normal coverage (~50x) includes one additional sample downsampled to ~5x coverage. At 5x, many positions fail snippy's minimum coverage threshold (--mincov, default 10). The low-coverage sample generates N calls at all under-threshold positions. snippy-core intersects all samples: every position that is N in the low-coverage sample becomes non-core for the entire dataset, shrinking the core genome proportionally to the fraction of the genome covered at ≥10x in the 5x sample (~30-50% of positions). The resulting SNP distances to the low-coverage sample are systematically underestimated (missing data treated as matches), and pairwise distances between the normal-coverage samples are also reduced by the shrinkage. The pipeline exits 0 with a plausible-looking phylogeny with compressed branch lengths.

known_behaviors.behavior: Runs successfully on the low-coverage sample. Reports lower variant counts than the other samples but no coverage warning in the main output. The per-base depth distribution is not summarized in the TSV output.

The --mincov threshold applied to the low-coverage sample forces many positions to N. Core genome shrinks. Exit 0. Branch lengths in the resulting tree are shorter than the true values; the low-coverage sample appears artificially close to all other samples.

samples.description: Salmonella Typhimurium LT2 — canonical complete Typhimurium reference

download.command: datasets download genome accession GCF_000006945.2 --include genome --filename genome.zip && unzip -q genome.zip && cat ncbi_dataset/data/GCF_000006945.2/*.fna > assembly.fasta && rm -rf ncbi_dataset genome.zip README.md

samples.description: Salmonella Typhimurium PNUSAS578491 downsampled to ~5x coverage using seqtk — simulates a failed library or low-input sample

recipe.description: Downsample SRR38944085 (PNUSAS578491, ~50x) to ~5x by taking 10% of reads using seqtk. Uses seed 42 for reproducibility.
recipe.command: seqtk sample -s42 ../ingroup_source/reads_1.fq.gz 0.10 | gzip > reads_1.fq.gz && seqtk sample -s42 ../ingroup_source/reads_2.fq.gz 0.10 | gzip > reads_2.fq.gz

download.command: echo 'low_cov_outlier is recipe-based; run acquire.py which will generate it from ingroup_source'

samples.description: Salmonella Typhimurium PNUSAS578491 — source reads for low_cov_outlier recipe; also used as a normal-coverage ingroup sample

download.command: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir . SRR38944085 && mv SRR38944085_1.fastq.gz reads_1.fq.gz && mv SRR38944085_2.fastq.gz reads_2.fq.gz

curation.notes: The low-coverage outlier is produced from the same strain as ingroup_source, so the 'true' SNP distance to the outlier is known (0 SNPs from ingroup_source). This makes the underestimation artifact clearly measurable: the pipeline will report the low-coverage sample as closer to some samples and farther from others solely due to missing data patterns, not biology.
